units.source_text: 长长的上行缓坡不断，猛地陡坡直下……

en.t: The long gentle uphill slope went on and on, then suddenly plunged down a steep descent...

units.source_text: 又忽地一道上行陡坡，进而又是长长的下行缓坡……

en.t: Then, all at once, there was a steep climb, followed again by a long gentle slope downward...

units.source_text: 他一脚高，一脚低，就像穿珠子似的，一步步攀登，不停地忍耐。

en.t: With one foot higher and the other lower, as if threading beads, he climbed step by step, enduring without pause.
At some point, the bell had stopped ringing.

units.source_text: 风声、海啸声、耳鸣声已经无法区别开来。

en.t: The sound of the wind, the roar of the sea, and the ringing in his ears could no longer be told apart.

units.source_text: 他又爬上一个斜坡，回头一看，追兵的灯消失了。

en.t: He climbed another slope, and when he looked back, the lights of his pursuers had disappeared.

units.source_text: 等他喘息稍定，灯还未出现。

en.t: By the time his breathing had steadied a little, the lights still had not appeared.
